main_text.p: tivi illi, μικρῦ ἐξέφυγε, parum abfuit quin effugeret: μικρῦ διήλθε, ferè evasit. Item ὀλίγου δεῖν, fermé.
main_text.head: Cap. 34. De nominibus urbium.
main_text.p: Nomen proprium urbis, regitur á præpositione. Homerus,
"Αργὸς ἐν Ιπποβότῳ Ἰαννέψ ἡ πότμον ὀπτάσθαι,

p.i: In Argo equorum nutrice mori, & fatalem sortem attrahere.

main_text.p: Joseph. κατηδρύσας αὐτὸν ἐν Ἱεριχοῦντι βασιλέα, ἔνθεν εἰς πλῆθος κακώσεως παρέλαβεν, ubi collocasset ipsi in Hierichunte regiam, nihil afflictionis in populum prætermittebat. Sic εἰς Λακεδαίμονα, in (vel ad) Lacedæmonem: εἰς Πέλλιον, in Pellium.

page.notes: Greek text is partly damaged and blurred by a stain near the middle of the page; Greek words in the Homer and Josephus lines are reconstructed from a poor scan and may contain errors. A dark ink smudge covers part of the Josephus line. The "FINIS" line is letterspaced in the original.
